A lawyer and a construction worker were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The lawyer recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the construction worker started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who did very well in high school?
A. Not known
B. The construction worker
C. The lawyer
